procedure.method: In this fresh independent turn I read only the explicitly pinned inputs and verified their byte hashes. I read all three pinned native-evidence manifests without following embedded paths. packet.source_assets and packet.protected_layouts were both empty. I then called view_image through functions.exec with detail=original and displayed each returned exact image via image(), one at a time, in this order: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine views were actually visible before I recorded any first transcription judgment or score. After those nine views I retained first raw reads in memory, recorded date/time dash-class uncertainties, and revisited each exact native asset once to resolve those uncertainties. No new asset, crop, regeneration, peer review or inferred maker scene was used. The nine ordered initial views are listed in viewed; the three ambiguity revisits are separately retained below. Native dimensions were read from PNG IHDR. An optional PIL diagnostic was unavailable; a read-only Python standard-library PNG decode later produced the disclosed RGB statistics. Visual monochrome fidelity is assessed from the displayed posters, without claiming exact RGB channel neutrality. No runner trace or session ID was inspected or invented.
limits: Source-asset and protected-layout fidelity comparisons are not applicable because neither was supplied.
Semantic viewing/order is my attestation; actual CLI freshness and trace identity belong to the runner.
RGB deviations are factual material diagnostics; visual monochrome does not assert bit-exact grayscale.

content_form.location: Upper lever macro and lower engaged-key macro
content_form.observation: Two large close views pair the rubbed contact surface of the lever with the scuffed head of a key inserted into its lock. Their shared use is communicated by actual hardware rather than a small symbol.

content_form.location: Top and bottom photographs around the information band
content_form.observation: The lever’s gripping face and the key’s handled head are both large enough for abrasion to remain visible; the content argument survives reduction.

hierarchy.location: Top photograph, central title and ordered information, lower key photograph
hierarchy.observation: The upper lever gives an immediate tactile subject; a one-line heavy title anchors the white band, followed by subtitle, date, venue, hours, admission and URL. The lower image returns attention to the key.
Both objects and the full title remain recognizable. The white band cleanly separates information from material detail, while smaller visitor copy becomes fine.

typography.observation: The full title is one line with complete Hangul. Smaller subtitle and regular supporting sans-serif have consistent left alignment and clear weight changes; the complete URL is kept on one line.
The visitor information remains readily readable at 720 pixels wide. The hours slash stays separate from URL protection, and the line ordering preserves all required entries.

space.location: Horizontal photo/band boundaries near y472 and y1040
space.observation: The upper and lower photographs occupy comparable substantial areas around the middle text band. The information has a common inset and clear group gaps; no text is laid over the scratched surfaces.
The strongly divided layout makes small-scale occupied/empty proportions deliberate. The band interrupts continuous door space but creates an effective information field.

image_material.location: Upper lever face and circular mount
image_material.observation: Fine longitudinal scratching, worn plating, an edge highlight and concentric mounting-plate marks are locally coherent. Contact shadows convincingly attach the hardware to the painted door.

image_material.location: Lower key head, beveled hole, shaft and lock
image_material.observation: Scuffs across the key head, a bright worn rim, a beveled hole and parallel shaft grooves remain distinct. The key actually enters the slot, with the blade’s working end concealed by the lock.

emotion_control.location: Close views of familiar hardware with neutral light
emotion_control.observation: Close attention to wear turns ordinary surfaces into evidence of repeated handling. The bright neutral presentation is intimate and matter-of-fact without sinister staging.

emotion_control.location: Unadorned exhibition information in the middle band
emotion_control.observation: The plain museum copy and absence of sales decoration support a life-history exhibition rather than antique retail or a crime poster.

ai_slop.location: Key-to-slot junction and mounting plate outlines
ai_slop.observation: The key’s grooves meet a plausible slot, and both circular fittings attach to the door with coherent outlines and shadows. No arbitrary badge, false artifact identifier or floating decorative object is present.

The two enlarged objects remain the substantive visual system; the white band has an information function rather than being empty filler. The conventional type treatment prevents a claim of exceptional specificity.
